title: Normal-Matrix Proof Memory Exemplar

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.

Approved 27-slice exemplar plan; s01-s25 authorized, s25 mandatory human checkpoint, s26-s27 require explicit post-checkpoint approval. Supersedes the metadata-incomplete v1 contract before execution.

allowedWork: One original normal-matrix Article, local semantic asset and vignette, static publication, route-local native-KaTeX stage, two attention cycles, compact checkpoint controls, eleven prompts, direct re-entry, focused accessibility and performance checks, visual checkpoint evidence, and required project-memory updates.
Exact independently reversible commits with bounded Theseus context and verification evidence.
disallowedWork: SVD, a second theorem, generic matrix or proof-memory APIs, shared renderer or Article grammar changes without a hard gap, scheduler, accounts, learner state, analytics, classrooms, assessment, new lesson layouts, Graph3D, Canvas, WebGL, particles, advanced editor work, broad LLM prose generation, or economics implementation.
Execution of s26 or s27 before explicit approval of the mandatory s25 human checkpoint.
goal: Implement one searchable normal-matrix proof, one deterministic native-KaTeX attention stage, eleven prompt projections, exact proof re-entry, and a static comparison through a mandatory human checkpoint without adding shared matrix, scheduler, or layout authority.
commitCadence: Commit each independently reversible verified slice with its completed Theseus evidence; never stage protected economics files or unrelated documents.
stopConditions: Stop if the proof or a prerequisite cannot be stated and reviewed rigorously.
Stop if implementation requires Article v2, a second clock, another paint owner, a generic matrix engine, or model-authored geometry or timing.
Stop if semantic identity must be inferred from glyph equality or KaTeX internals, or if static and motion evidence disagree mathematically.
Stop if direct restoration requires replay or if no-JavaScript truth, accessibility, 390-pixel fit, or approved route budgets fail without an independently removable correction.
Stop before modifying user-owned economics or unrelated untracked work.
Stop at s25 for mandatory human visual and product judgment; do not begin s26 without explicit approval.
